meta.name: Doxmate Clinical Dashboard Design System
meta.description: A clean, professional SaaS dashboard design system for healthcare/clinic management. Prioritises clarity, information density, and workflow efficiency over decorative elements. The aesthetic is modern corporate SaaS — flat, card-based, with subtle depth through shadows and colour-coded status indicators.
designPhilosophy: Consistent use of colour to encode status and severity
Progressive disclosure via modals and collapsible sections
Minimal decoration — whitespace and alignment do the heavy lifting
Accessible contrast ratios for medical professionals working long hours

cursorInstructions.howToUse: Feed this JSON to Cursor (or any AI coding assistant) as context when building UI components. Reference specific sections like components.modal.variants.fullForm or colorPalette.semantic.success to ensure consistency.
keyPrinciples: Always use the purple-gradient header (#5B4FC4 to #7C6FDB) for modals that represent detail/form views
Use uppercase small-caps labels (11px, 600 weight, 0.05em tracking) for all field labels
Action buttons in modals always go in the footer: secondary outline left, primary filled right
Toast notifications are always green (#22C55E) background with white text, top-right position
Avatar circles use name-derived initials with consistent per-letter colour hashing
Status is always communicated through colour: green=success/positive, amber=waiting/warning, red=danger/pending, blue=info, purple=active/primary
Card border-radius is always 12px, button border-radius is 8px, pills are 9999px
Sections in list views are grouped by collapsible status headers with coloured labels and count badges
The sidebar active item uses a filled purple background with white text and no other decoration
Tables use uppercase, letter-spaced, grey column headers and never bold or dark headers
Forms use a 2-column grid inside modals and a left-sidebar + main-content split for full-page forms
Empty states show a faded icon, grey heading, and lighter subtext, all centered
